sqlquery.from:
( with myUserRoles as (select mu.id userID,r.code userRole,cc.crmcontactid,c.crmAccount,e.id employee,te.teamID from "$".myuser mu left join "$".clientcontact cc on cc.id=mu.id left join "$".myuser_role mr on mr.users_id=mu.id left join "$".role r on mr.roles_id=r.id and r.isdeleted is not true left join "$".crmContact c on cc.crmcontactid=c.id and c.deleted is not true left join "$".employee e on mu.id=e.id left join "$".teamEmployee te on te.employeeId=e.id and te.isdeleted is not true where mu.deleted is not true)
select c.id,caseNumberString,subject,r.name priorityName,c.creationDate ,cor.name caseOrigionName from "$".crmcase c left join "$".reference r on c.priority=r.id left join "$".reference cor on c.caseOrigion=cor.id , (select id from "$".myuser u where id=#?user_id?#) u left join(select max(crmcontactid) crmcontactid,userID, max(crmAccount) crmAccount,max(teamID) teamID , case max(case userRole when 'CLIENT' then 0 else 1 end) when 0 then 1 else 0 end onlyClientAccess , max(case userRole when 'ADMIN' then 1 else 0 end) isAdmin , max(case employee when userid then 1 else 0 end) isEmployee , max(case when userRole in ('ADMIN','DR','SALESMAN','CUSTOMER_SERVICE_MANAGER') then 1 else 0 end) hasEitherRoles from myUserRoles group by userID) roles on u.id=roles.userID where c.deleted is not true and c.inTrash is not true and ( roles.isAdmin=1 or (roles.onlyClientAccess =1 and (roles.crmcontactid=c.releatedto or roles.crmAccount=c.crmAccount)) or (roles.isEmployee=1 and roles.hasEitherRoles=0 and (u.id in (c.owner, c.resolver) or (roles.teamID is not null and roles.teamID=c.department_id and c.owner is null))) ) ) t
